fields.label: AI handoff owner
fields.description: Fallback for skill handoffs; must have access to the conversation.

fields.label: Voice transcription provider
fields.description: Transcribes received voice notes in the background. Requires an enabled OpenAI provider with a transcription model.

fields.label: Send WhatsApp read receipts
fields.description: When an operator reads a one-to-one WhatsApp chat, the customer sees blue ticks on the newest message.

fields.label: Show WhatsApp typing indicator
fields.description: While an operator types a reply, the customer sees a typing indicator. WhatsApp also marks their newest message as read.
